'''Hans van Abeelen''' (20 November 1936 &ndash; 21 August 1998) was the first Dutch [[Behavioural genetics|behaviour geneticist]]. He obtained his [[M.Sc]] from the [[University of Groningen]] and his [[Ph.D.]] from the [[Radboud University Nijmegen|Catholic University of Nijmegen]] in 1965, where he stayed for the rest of his career as "wetenschappelijk hoofdmedewerker". He was a founding member of the [[Behavior Genetics Association]] and was a member-at-large of its executive committee from 1984 till 1987.<ref>{{cite book |title=The 45th Annual Meeting of the Behavior Genetics Association |date=2015 |publisher=Behavior Genetics Association |location=San Diego, CA, USA |page=7 |url=http://bga.org/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/2015_BGA-San-Diego-2015.pdf}}</ref> He also served on the [[editorial board]] of its journal, [[Behavior Genetics (journal)|''Behavior Genetics'']], from its creation in 1971 to 1992. Van Abeelen took [[Retirement|early retirement]] in 1991, but nevertheless became one of the founding members of the [[International Behavioural and Neural Genetics Society]]. Over the span of his career, he published 64 articles and book chapters<ref name="urlObit">{{cite web |url=http://www.mousebehavior.com/obituary/Obit-vA.html |title=Obituary J.H.F. van Abeelen |author=Wim E. Crusio |author-link=Wim Crusio |access-date=2009-02-08}}</ref> and edited a book, ''The Genetics of Behaviour'',<ref>{{cite book |editor1-first=J.H.F. |editor1-last=van Abeelen |title=The Genetics of Behaviour |year=1974 |publisher=North Holland |location=Amsterdam |isbn=0-7204-7137-0 |pages=450 |oclc=1365968}}</ref> which was an early overview of European behaviour genetics.<ref name="Raaijmakers">{{cite journal | author = W. Raaijmakers | title = In memoriam dr JFH (Hans) van Abeelen | journal = Mededelingenblad van de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Gedragsbiologie | volume = 7 | issue = 1 | pages = 6 |date=September 1998 | url = http://www.gedragsbiologie.nl/NVG_nieuwsbrief/NVG_07_1.pdf | access-date = 2009-02-08}}</ref>
